# DailyPulse

> DailyPulse is a public news website hosted on GitHub Pages. It presents news through category-based feeds, including science, sports, business, cryptocurrency, and banking.

## Website

- Homepage: https://onlyonedev8.github.io/online/
- Sitemap: https://onlyonedev8.github.io/online/sitemap.xml

## Content and access notes

- The homepage is the primary public page currently listed in the sitemap.
- News categories may be loaded dynamically from feed files.
- Prefer original publisher links and publication dates when referencing news.
- Attribute reporting to the original publisher.
- Do not assume that every feed item is a separate DailyPulse article page.

## For automated systems

Use the public homepage and sitemap to discover the site. Respect robots.txt and applicable source-site terms. Access to these files does not guarantee indexing, crawling, or inclusion in AI answers.
